rationale: The plan uses DESeq2 Wald (plus edgeR QL as a cross-check) with design ~condition, control releveled as reference, matching the unpaired 3v3 single-batch design exactly, and explicitly reasons about the 4 residual df consequences throughout rather than generically. QC (library size, PCA with %variance, sample distance/correlation heatmaps, outlier policy that forbids dropping a sample) precedes testing, and filtering uses filterByExpr on the design with reporting of retained gene count. Normalization is handled inside DESeq2/edgeR (size factors/TMM), with no pre-normalization of counts. BH FDR at stated 0.05/0.1 thresholds plus apeglm shrinkage for reported/ranked LFCs is done correctly, with explicit anti-p-hacking constraints (no relaxing alpha, no fold-change pre-filtering) and a strong, dataset-specific n=3 power/stability audit that avoids circular post-hoc power and correctly frames leave-one-out as stability not validation. Enrichment is well justified (rank-based fgsea with named ranking metric, human hallmark/GO-BP, ORA caveated, universe restriction noted), losing a point only for not stating explicit set-size window/collection version. Reporting is thorough, naming methods, thresholds, gene counts, direction, and design caveats, though exact software version numbers are not pinned down.
